name: Yamasugata Jaguar
original_name: ヤマスガタ・ジャガー
source:
Jaguar is a second-year at Southern Cross High School, and, like [url=/c80917]Tiger[/url], serves as a maid for [url=/c80914]Sugata[/url] and is also quite skilled in martial arts. In contrast to Tiger though, she is much more serious and easier to irk. [spoiler]Both she and Tiger's main mission is to keep watch on Sugata and kill him in case he tries to flee the island or claim ownership of Samekh, but even after they learn that he joined the Glittering Crux, they could not bear to do it. [/spoiler]

[From [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Star_Driver_characters#Other_Characters]Wikipedia[/url].]
